description.narrative: (Liberia): Building on the success and lessons learned from USAID's Liberia Accountability and Voice Initiative, which strengthened civil society capacity to advocate successfully for key reforms in natural resource management, education, and elections, USAID is implementing a five-year civil society activity to strengthen the capacity of Liberian citizens to advocate for and monitor government policy reforms. .Using FY 2022 funds, interventions under the new activity may include: 1) building civil society coalitions around priority issues within Liberia; 2) building the capacity of civil society organizations to engage effectively with constituents and officials on priority reforms, 3) ensure that coalition members' achievements are sustainable by building financial resilience and adaptive capacities and 4) developing the skills of local private sector service providers to meet the needs of supported CSOs engaged in advocacy. In USAID's FY 2022 Liberia Country Roadmap civil society and media effectiveness ranks .90 out of 1 (one being the "ideal" scenario), confirming the opportunity to capitalize on civil society's ability to promote government accountability and reform.
